name: Patience
overview: Scripture reveals patience as a vital virtue that trusts in God's perfect timing and sovereign provision, as seen when God assures that He will fulfill His promises at the appointed time (Genesis 18:14) and when Isaac endured setbacks with wells being stopped (Genesis 26:15). Patience involves waiting confidently for God's salvation (Genesis 49:18) and responding without complaint even amid hardship, exemplified by the Israelites' murmuring and Moses' reminder that their struggle was ultimately with the Lord (Exodus 16:7-8). Job's humble acceptance of loss, blessing the name of the Lord despite suffering (Job 1:21), further illustrates enduring faith. Together, these passages encourage believers to patiently trust God's providence, maintain composure through trials, and wait on Him with steadfast hope.
